question: Should OpenClaw accept the proposed one-Claw-one-new-agent package and lifecycle contract, narrow its initial scope, or continue incubation?
rationale: Patch correctness cannot establish whether these cross-repository CLI, manifest, ownership, provenance, and upgrade surfaces should become supported product contracts.

options.title: Continue incubation
options.body: Keep the RFC draft while maintainers gather further compatibility and upgrade evidence from the linked experimental implementation stacks.

options.title: Accept and transition
options.body: Approve the complete contract, create the implementation issue, update the frontmatter to accepted with the issue URL, and merge.

options.title: Narrow before acceptance
options.body: Approve a smaller initial lifecycle and defer selected update, export, MCP, cron, CLAW.md, or shared-package semantics.

recommendation.title: Continue incubation
recommendation.body: Keep the RFC draft while maintainers gather further compatibility and upgrade evidence from the linked experimental implementation stacks.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the concrete product-model revision adopted by the current RFC and are the strongest visible discussion-based routing candidate for this contract decision.
